utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, all. Everyone survive the weekend? My grand plans for the garden lasted about ten minutes before the rain arrived.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Ten minutes? You did better than us. Didn't even get the chairs out.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'd settle for the heating in the portakabin making its mind up. Coat on, coat off, all morning. Just having a moan, not reporting a job.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's the deluxe climate control. Two settings, both wrong.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the weather forecast. Monday the ninth, morning stand-up. What's already closed out?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I tested the air dryer yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's the air dryer test done, then? Nothing outstanding from that?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Correct. Done and dusted.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the 11kV Switchboard on Tuesday. That's old news, really, but it was still coming up in conversation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Last Tuesday, yeah? We're talking completed work.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, last Tuesday. Signed off, not another inspection for today.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: One observation as well: noticed the water ring was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Settled back down, yeah. Not something we're opening work on from that.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. Just passing on what I saw.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I heard a slight rattle from the big valve by the gate, nothing to action yet. Before that turns into a strip-down on someone's list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. The rattle itself isn't a new job.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, just an observation at this point.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Separate from that noise, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the big valve by the gate by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace Liu. Permit to work and isolation for the big valve by the gate, by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, that's mine. By 11am.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just keeping the distinction clear—permit and isolation, not me being volunteered to chase the rattle?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. No extra investigation being added there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. What have we got that's still blocked?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I can't get to the palletizer until production gives us a window. Still stuck on that, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: There's no window confirmed. So it's not a commitment we can put into today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, stays blocked. We're not pretending that's going ahead.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the CT1 either.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, no confirmed delivery date. Nothing firm to plan against.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Blocker noted, no assumption that it's arriving today.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: A delivery date would be a lovely novelty, wouldn't it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And we were going to replace the belt on the trucks but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it. Cancelled out of today's work.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: One less ghost job following us round, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Not quietly putting it back in.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: On the admin bit, I'll sort the training records for the new starters by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Marcus. Training records for the new starters, by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll take that. Thursday, not claiming they're finished already.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's the records themselves you're talking about, rather than extra training sessions?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The records, yeah. That's the job I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got you. By Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I'll run a function test on the dryer. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Pri has the function test on the dryer. No rush.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah. And that's separate from the air dryer test we were just talking about.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep—my air dryer test is finished. We're not reopening that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over you there. Heard 'dryer' twice and thought Teams had started looping.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, just us being us. I'll do the function test on the dryer, no rush, no deadline added.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: There's also a site visit at Kestrel with the contractor that needs doing. Not an emergency but don't let it slip. It hasn't got anyone against it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Is anyone able to take that site visit at Kestrel with the contractor?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I can't take it on.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I can't commit to that either, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, not one I can pick up.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Still nobody, then. I'm raising the gap, not volunteering for the visit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. We agree it needs doing, but Kestrel stays unallocated. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Other gap: the sensors on the GT2 water valve need recalibrating this afternoon. It matters but it's not urgent. Nobody's got that as far as I know.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, did you say this afternoon, but not urgent? Just making sure I've heard both bits.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah. Recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 water valve this afternoon. It matters but it's not urgent. I'm flagging it, not taking it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Any taker for that recalibration?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I can't put my name to it. Don't want my question sounding like an offer.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nor me, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's unowned as well. The sensors on the GT2 water valve need recalibrating this afternoon; it matters but it's not urgent. No owner agreed.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Agreed. Both that and the site visit at Kestrel with the contractor remain unallocated. Not putting either against someone by default.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. For the three things people have taken, just give me a quick yes on what you've committed to.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep. I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the big valve by the gate by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'll sort the training records for the new starters by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I'll run a function test on the dryer. No rush.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Lovely. And my portakabin moan remains strictly a moan.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Duly recorded as British conversation, not maintenance. Thanks, everyone. We'll leave it there.
